Revenant.profileName: Revenant maxed-out tier, final (2026-10-01): RTM rules, Unstable Crystal Card's explosion modelled (it kills), bought + skill rolls -- win 98% lost 0% 45,720 dps 4s 565 kills/h (sit 0.3s) 2.3 deaths/h

Scythe Reap.name: Scythe Reap
Scythe Reap.desc:
A multi-strike slash that cuts the skin and can immobilize the enemy for 4 s.
Damage: 150% + 25% per level + 2% per LUK
Damage is slightly boosted by weapon weight.
Can crit.
Grants or refreshes Combo Ready for 4 s, also when autocast.
Requires a Scythe.
Delay decreases with skill level.
Cooldown: 1 s
Scythe Reap.summary: Your combo opener: a three-slash hit that turns on Combo Ready for 4 s. Recast it whenever Combo Ready is about to drop.

Reaping Slash.name: Reaping Slash
Reaping Slash.desc:
You slash all targets in a 5x5 area around you and gain an Overslash stack.
Damage: 110% + 10% per level + 2% per LUK
+5% damage per Overslash stack.
Can crit.
Grants 1 Overslash stack per cast, but only goes past 1 stack under Combo Ready.
Under Finisher Ready, it instantly maximizes your stacks if you have Combo Ready and already 1 or more stacks.
Overslash stacks increase the power of Roaring Overslash and Underworld Rainstorm.
Overslash stacks: max 5, last 6 s.
Cooldown: 1.5 s
Cost: 5 SP per level, plus 5% of current HP per cast
Reaping Slash.summary: Spin attack around you that builds Overslash stacks (max 5, last 6 s). Needs Combo Ready to go past 1 stack; with Finisher Ready up it jumps straight to 5 — and it always ends Finisher Ready. Costs 5% of your current HP.

Hellraiser.name: Hellraiser
Hellraiser.desc:
You strike your weapon into the ground, causing a strong explosion that damages all enemies around you.
Damage: 250% + 15% per level + 3% per LUK
Damage is always Fire element.
Can crit.
Grants Finisher Ready for 5 s.
Cast: 0.5 s variable
Cooldown: 12 s
Hellraiser.summary: Fire explosion around you that grants Finisher Ready for 5 s. Cast it with 1 Overslash stack, so the next Reaping Slash takes you to 5.

Sweeping Slash.name: Sweeping Slash
Sweeping Slash.desc:
You sweep the target's legs with your scythe.
Damage: 200% + 25% per level + 2% per LUK, per hit
Damage is greatly reduced outside combos.
Deals 2 separate hits, or 3 under Finisher Ready.
Can crit.
Cooldown: 2.5 s
Sweeping Slash.summary: Two-hit filler (three under Finisher Ready) that also refreshes Combo Ready for 3 s. Weak outside a combo.

Haunting Slice.name: Haunting Slice
Haunting Slice.desc:
You quickly reach the target and attack.
Damage is fixed, based on ATK and STR.
Range: 3 cells + 1 per level
20% chance per level to autocast Scythe Reap, at Haunting Slice's skill level.
Cooldown: 7 s
Haunting Slice.summary: Dash to the target; at Lv5 it always autocasts Scythe Reap for free — a gap closer that also restarts Combo Ready.

Roaring Overslash.name: Roaring Overslash
Roaring Overslash.desc:
You draw crosses in the sky, damaging a 7x7 area.
Damage: 150% + 15% per level + 2% per LUK
Damage is reduced without Combo Ready.
Deals one extra hit per Overslash stack.
Can crit.
Cooldown: 7 s
Cost: also 10% of current SP per cast
Roaring Overslash.summary: Your finisher: one hit, plus one extra full hit per Overslash stack (6 hits at 5 stacks). Does not use up the stacks. Weaker without Combo Ready. Costs 10% of current SP.

Phantom Slice.name: Phantom Slice
Phantom Slice.desc:
You throw your scythe at a distant enemy and pull it close to you. Can be used on a party member, but then deals no damage.
Damage: 100% + 20% per level + 2% per VIT
Range: 3 cells + 1 per level
Cooldown: 1 s
Phantom Slice.summary: Ranged scythe throw that pulls the target in. A cheap 1-second-cooldown filler between combos.

Flaming Wave.name: Flaming Wave
Flaming Wave.desc:
You set the ground on fire around the targeted enemy, which can inflict Burning on enemies there.
Damage: 30% per level + 3% per INT
Burning chance: 5% per level
Burning duration: 2.5 s + 0.5 s per level
Cooldown: 5 s
Flaming Wave.summary: Fire line that can set targets Burning. Scales on INT, so weak on a STR/LUK build — only a filler.

Dark Message.name: Dark Message
Dark Message.desc:
You push the targeted enemy back 3 cells. The damage is very small; the skill is mainly for control.
Damage: 10% per level + 1% per STR
Damage is based on MATK instead of ATK.
Only Small targets take full damage.
Grants Combo Ready for 1 s per level.
Grants Cast Ready for 1 s per level.
Cast: 0.5 s variable + 0.1 s fixed
Cooldown: 7 s
Dark Message.summary: Small push that grants Combo Ready and Cast Ready (variable cast −95%) — used to make Underworld Rainstorm instant.

Underworld Rainstorm.name: Underworld Rainstorm
Underworld Rainstorm.desc:
You summon a rain of rays from the underworld that keeps striking enemies in an 11x11 area for 3 s.
Damage: 2% per level + 1% per 2 points of LUK and INT combined
+4% damage per Overslash stack.
Enemies are hit every 0.2 s for the 3 s duration.
Never misses.
The cast can't be interrupted, but your defences are halved while casting.
Requires a Shadow Orb.
Cast: 5 s variable + 0.5 s fixed
Cooldown: 12 s
Underworld Rainstorm.summary: Rain of hits on an 11x11 area for 3 s, +4% per Overslash stack. Its 5 s cast is cut by Dark Message's Cast Ready or removed by Royal Scythe.

Darkside Shadow.name: Darkside Shadow
Darkside Shadow.desc:
You summon your shadow to repeat your normal attacks, letting you use Double Attack with a Scythe.
All physical skills gain +2% damage scaling per DEX; this bonus is halved for Underworld Rainstorm.
Double Attack chance: 10% per level
Duration: 15 s per level
Cooldown: 60 s
Darkside Shadow.summary: Pre-fight buff, 150 s: your shadow gives normal attacks a 100% Double Attack chance, and every physical skill gains +2% damage per DEX.

True Sight.name: True Sight
True Sight.desc:
You focus to improve your combat ability for a short time.
+3 to all stats.
+3 HIT and +3 crit per level.
Duration: 60 s
Cooldown: 80 s
True Sight.summary: Pre-fight buff, 60 s: +3 to all stats, +30 HIT and +30 crit; also +20% to every weapon attack's ratio (server code).

Vampire Mark.name: Vampire Mark
Vampire Mark.desc:
You infuse blood into yourself or an ally, letting physical damage leech HP.
Leech chance: 10% per level
Leech power: 3% per level
Does not work with magic damage.
Duration: 60 s at Lv1, 5 s less per level (40 s at Lv5)
Cooldown: 60 s
Vampire Mark.summary: Pre-fight buff, 40 s: physical hits have a 50% chance to heal you for 15% of the damage. Feeds the Ominous Presence shield.

Shadow Parry.name: Shadow Parry
Shadow Parry.desc:
You block physical attacks with your scythe. After a successful block you pause for a moment.
Block chance: 10% + 2% per level
Requires a Scythe.
Duration: 20 s + 10 s per level
Cost: also 5% of Max SP per cast
Shadow Parry.summary: Pre-fight buff, 120 s: blocks 30% of physical hits (normal attacks and weapon skills) outright.

Burning Scythe.name: Burning Scythe
Burning Scythe.desc:
Your weapon gains the Fire element for the skill's duration.
Duration: 30 s per level
Cast: 1 s variable + 1 s fixed
Burning Scythe.summary: Fire endow, cast before the pull only when Fire beats your weapon's element on the target (Holy monsters, for a Neutral or Holy scythe).

Ominous Presence.name: Ominous Presence
Ominous Presence.desc:
Passive: improves the leech effects and overheal of Scythes.
Overheal (scythe HP leech): leeching HP while at full health turns into a shield.
Shield duration: 30 s, refreshed by each new overheal.
Shield max: Max HP + (10% x level) x (STR + 2 x LUK + base level) x Leech Power
Leech Power counts in percentage points (5% = 5) and must be above 0.
Conversion: 8% per skill level against a single target, 4% per skill level when the hit strikes several targets.
Ominous Presence.summary: Passive: leech that would overheal you becomes a shield (80% of the overheal), up to Max HP + your STR/LUK/level times Leech Power. This is what keeps a low-HP Revenant alive.

Satsujin.profileName: Satsujin farm, maxed-out tier A (2026-10-01): 10 endgame areas, free for all except +10, bought + skill rolls; from standard-rings -- win 98% lost 0% 79,042 dps 2s 778 kills/h (sit 0.5s) 0.3 deaths/h

Shadow Slash.name: Shadow Slash
Shadow Slash.desc:
You dash to the target and make 3 critical hit attempts.
Damage: 200% + 15% per level + 1% per LUK
Only the right-hand weapon's ATK is used.
+5% damage per Improve Dodge level while under Hallucination Walk.
Bonus crit rate: 5 + 5 per level
Requires a Dagger or Sword.
Cooldown: 4 s
Shadow Slash.summary: Dash-in opener: three crit attempts on the target. Puts you in melee instantly.

New Moon.name: New Moon
New Moon.desc:
Moon skill: you attack nearby enemies and enter New Moon, hiding for 5 s. You stay hidden until you attack.
Damage: 150% + 30% per level + 5% per AGI
Focus: +5% per level per Focus stack.
Autocasting it loses your Focus stacks.
While hidden, you take half damage.
Cast: 1 s variable
Cooldown: 5 s
Cost: 1 SP per second while hidden
New Moon.summary: Starts the Moon combo: hits around you and turns you invisible (halves damage taken) until you attack. Scales with AGI and Elemental Focus.

Full Moon.name: Full Moon
Full Moon.desc:
Moon skill, usable only in New Moon: ends New Moon and damages nearby enemies.
Damage: 250% + 50% per level + 8% per AGI
Focus: +10% per level per Focus stack.
High chance to inflict Blind.
Grants Combo Ready for 5 s.
Cost: also 10% of current SP per cast
Full Moon.summary: Only from New Moon: the big hit of the combo (AGI and Focus scaling), and it grants Combo Ready.

Million Stab.name: Million Stab
Million Stab.desc:
You rapidly stab the target and nearby enemies for physical damage.
Damage: 20% + 5% per level + 1% per AGI
Under Combo Ready: +1% per DEX. Does not consume Combo Ready.
Cast: variable, from 1 s down to 0.1 s with level
Cooldown: 5 s
Million Stab.summary: Rapid stabs; only cast under Combo Ready, where DEX adds to it.

Dragon Omamori.name: Dragon Omamori
Dragon Omamori.desc:
You attach a talisman to the target and deal physical damage. Omamori Jutsu detonates the talisman for stronger damage.
Apply damage: 50% + 10% per level
Explosion damage: 200% + 50% per level + 2% per DEX
Under Combo Ready: +5% per STR.
Talismans last 50 s; one talisman per target.
Cast: 0.5 s variable
Cost: also 5% of Max SP per talisman
Dragon Omamori.summary: Puts a talisman on the target (cast under Combo Ready); Omamori Jutsu detonates it.

Omamori Jutsu.name: Omamori Jutsu
Omamori Jutsu.desc:
You detonate all your Dragon Omamori and Binding Omamori talismans on screen.
Makes you invisible when used.
Cooldown: 5 s
Omamori Jutsu.summary: Detonates your Dragon Omamori talisman for big damage, and makes you invisible — which lets Full Moon follow.

Thousand Arms.name: Thousand Arms
Thousand Arms.desc:
You spin quickly, hitting all enemies in a 7x7 area around you several times.
Damage: 200% + 20% per level + 5% per AGI
Cooldown: 3 s
Cost: also 5% of current HP
Thousand Arms.summary: 7x7 spin filler between Moon combos; costs 5% current HP.

Kawarimi.name: Kawarimi
Kawarimi.desc:
You enter Kawarimi, automatically dodging a set number of attacks. After each dodge you move back 1 cell.
Lv1: 2 s, 1 dodge
Lv2: 2.5 s, 1 dodge
Lv3: 3 s, 2 dodges
Lv4: 3.5 s, 2 dodges
Lv5: 4 s, 3 dodges
Cooldown: 20 s
Kawarimi.summary: Dodge: the next physical hit misses and you step back a cell.

Back Stab.name: Back Stab
Back Stab.desc:
You teleport behind the enemy and strike.
Damage: 150% + 5% per level + 1% per AGI
Single-wielding a Dagger: the AGI bonus and the per-level bonus are tripled, plus 5% scaling per Improve Dodge level.
The enemy's back must be unobstructed.
Requires a Sword or Dagger.
Cooldown: 3 s
Cost: also 5% of current SP

Moonlight Stance.name: Moonlight Stance
Moonlight Stance.desc:
You take a stance that works with the moonlight. Moon skills can only be used while it is active.
+2% Max HP per level.
Cost: also 50% of current SP
Moonlight Stance.summary: Pre-fight stance: required for every Moon skill, and +2% Max HP per level.

Seven Winds.name: Seven Winds
Seven Winds.desc:
A wind enchants your attacks with an element for 5 minutes; the element depends on the skill level.
Lv1: Earth
Lv2: Wind
Lv3: Water
Lv4: Fire
Lv5: Ghost
Lv6: Dark
Lv7: Holy
Cost: 50 SP (every level)
Seven Winds.summary: Pre-fight endow: picks the element that hits the target hardest for 5 minutes.

Hallucination Walk.name: Hallucination Walk
Hallucination Walk.desc:
Raises your movement speed to the maximum, increases FLEE and gives a chance to avoid magic attacks.
FLEE: +10 per level
Magic damage avoid chance: 5% per level
Requires a Shadow Orb.
Duration: 25 s + 5 s per level
Cooldown: 120 s

Magic Pierce.name: Magic Pierce
Magic Pierce.desc:
Your spells ignore part of the enemy's MDEF. Can be cast on others.
MDEF penetration: 3 per level
DEF penetration: 1 per level; works on autocasts.
Cast: 3 s variable + 1 s fixed

Wind Blade.name: Wind Blade
Wind Blade.desc:
You strike with Wind magic: 50% MATK a hit, 1 hit per level (up to 10).
Elemental Focus gained: 1 at Lv 1-3, 3 at Lv 4-6, 5 at Lv 7-10; up to 10 stacks, 60 s each.
Each Wind Focus stack: +7% magic damage of that element; half for stacks of another element.
Changing element converts the existing stacks (they keep their time left); the new cast still adds its own.
At the cap, new stacks replace the oldest; only those get a fresh duration.
At max Wind Focus: your weapon takes the Wind element and deals +10% damage vs Water.
The cast can't be interrupted.
Cast: 0.25 s to 7 s variable + 0.075 s to 0.75 s fixed, rising with level (SP cost too)
Cooldown: 0.5 s + 0.25 s per level
Wind Blade.summary: Cast twice before the pull for 10 Wind Focus stacks when Seven Winds is on Wind: the Moon skills gain damage per Focus stack.

Flaming Petals.name: Flaming Petals
Flaming Petals.desc:
You strike with Fire magic: 50% MATK a hit, 1 hit per level (up to 10).
Elemental Focus gained: 1 at Lv 1-3, 3 at Lv 4-6, 5 at Lv 7-10; up to 10 stacks, 60 s each.
Each Fire Focus stack: +7% magic damage of that element; half for stacks of another element.
Changing element converts the existing stacks (they keep their time left); the new cast still adds its own.
At the cap, new stacks replace the oldest; only those get a fresh duration.
At max Fire Focus: your weapon takes the Fire element and deals +10% damage vs Earth.
The cast can't be interrupted.
Cast: 0.25 s to 7 s variable + 0.075 s to 0.75 s fixed, rising with level (SP cost too)
Cooldown: 0.5 s + 0.25 s per level
Flaming Petals.summary: Cast twice before the pull for 10 Fire Focus stacks when Seven Winds is on Fire: the Moon skills gain damage per Focus stack.

Freezing Spear.name: Freezing Spear
Freezing Spear.desc:
You strike with Water magic: 50% MATK a hit, 1 hit per level (up to 10).
Elemental Focus gained: 1 at Lv 1-3, 3 at Lv 4-6, 5 at Lv 7-10; up to 10 stacks, 60 s each.
Each Water Focus stack: +7% magic damage of that element; half for stacks of another element.
Changing element converts the existing stacks (they keep their time left); the new cast still adds its own.
At the cap, new stacks replace the oldest; only those get a fresh duration.
At max Water Focus: your weapon takes the Water element and deals +10% damage vs Fire.
The cast can't be interrupted.
Cast: 0.25 s to 7 s variable + 0.075 s to 0.75 s fixed, rising with level (SP cost too)
Cooldown: 0.5 s + 0.25 s per level
Freezing Spear.summary: Cast twice before the pull for 10 Water Focus stacks when Seven Winds is on Water: the Moon skills gain damage per Focus stack.

Kingslayer.profileName: Kingslayer endgame farming (2026-09-30): unrestricted gear search over 10 areas (MVPs out, areas weighted equally), kills/h with deaths and stalls penalised

Bishop's Tax.name: Bishop's Tax
Bishop's Tax.desc:
You strike and tax the enemy's defences, making it take more damage.
Damage: 200% + 30% per level + 2% per DEX
Enemies hit take 15% more damage for 3 s to 12 s, by level.
Cooldown: 10 s
Cost: also 25% of Max HP
Bishop's Tax.summary: Hit that makes the target take 15% more damage for up to 12 s; cast right before Shield Boomerang into King's Chains. Costs 25% Max HP.

Shield Boomerang.name: Shield Boomerang
Shield Boomerang.desc:
You quickly throw your shield at an enemy.
Damage: 200% + 20% per level + 1% per VIT
Damage is improved by shield refine and weight.
Cooldown: 3 s
Shield Boomerang.summary: Shield throw that opens the King's Chains combo (x1.5 with the Bulwark Gem).

King's Chains.name: King's Chains
King's Chains.desc:
You throw a rebounding shield at an enemy 4 times.
Damage: 200% + 10% per level + 1% per VIT + 1% per STR
Damage is based on shield refine and weight. Weapon ATK does not apply; only your base ATK and the shield count.
+1% per VIT per Duel Counter.
+1% per point of soft DEF and hard DEF.
Finisher Ready: +30% per % of missing HP.
Ignores FLEE.
Requires a Shield and 1 Duel Counter.
Cast: 0.4 s variable + 0.1 s fixed
Cooldown: 8 s
Cost: also 15% of current SP
King's Chains.summary: The main hit: four shield throws, scaling with VIT, STR and your Duel Counters; spends one counter.

terms.text: +1% per Soft DEF and Hard DEF

Rook's Smash.name: Rook's Smash
Rook's Smash.desc:
You slide onto the target, smash a small area and push enemies away from where you land. Usable with any weapon.
Damage: 150% + 5% per level + 1% per STR
Additional damage equal to 1/5 of your Max HP.
+25% damage per Duel Counter.
Deals 2 hits, each at full damage; 3 on a target that cannot be knocked back.
Under Duel Stance, generates up to 3 Duel Counters.
Requires a Shield.
Cooldown: 8 s
Rook's Smash.summary: Slide onto the target for 2-3 hits plus a fifth of your current HP as damage; fills Duel Counters to 3.

Duel Stance.name: Duel Stance
Duel Stance.desc:
Physical attacks you receive can give you Duel Counters, which boost other Duelist skills based on VIT. Drains some SP at regular intervals while active.
Counter chance: 25% + 15% per level
Max 10 Duel Counters.
+2% Max HP per level.
Learning this skill disables Flip Coin.
Cast: 0.5 s fixed
Duel Stance.summary: Pre-fight stance: physical hits you take build Duel Counters; +Max HP.

King's Fortress.name: King's Fortress
King's Fortress.desc:
Your shield gains an aura that improves your flow of energy, depending on the level used.
Lv1: regenerate 1% HP every 2 s.
Lv2: regenerate 1% SP every 2 s.
Lv3: King's Chains and Shield Boomerang gain +1% per STR and +2% per VIT damage scaling.
Fortress bonus for Cover Ally: Lv1 takes 75% less damage; Lv2 gets Hallucination Walk; Lv3 gets the Endure effect.
Requires a Shield.
Duration: 5 minutes
Cast: 10 s variable
Cooldown: 60 s
King's Fortress.summary: Pre-fight shield aura; at Lv3 it adds STR and VIT scaling to King's Chains and Shield Boomerang.

Knight's Regen.name: Knight's Regen
Knight's Regen.desc:
You and all party members on screen recover a share of HP every 5 s. No effect on Undead-element players.
Recovery: 1% + 1% of Max HP per level
Duration: 60 s + 60 s per level
Cast: 4 s variable + 2 s fixed
Cooldown: 60 s
Cost: also 50% of Max SP
Knight's Regen.summary: Pre-fight regen: heals a share of Max HP every 5 s for minutes.

Bishop's Guard.name: Bishop's Guard
Bishop's Guard.desc:
Increases Max HP and VIT-based physical defence for you and all party members.
Max HP: +500 per level
VIT defence: +10% per level
Duration: 5 minutes
Cast: 3.5 s variable + 1.5 s fixed
Cost: also 10% of Max HP
Bishop's Guard.summary: Pre-fight buff: +500 Max HP per level and more VIT defence.

Reflect Shield.name: Reflect Shield
Reflect Shield.desc:
Reflects part of the damage from short-range physical attacks back at the attacker.
Reflected damage: 10% + 4% per level
Requires a Shield.
Reflect Shield.summary: Pre-fight buff: sends a share of melee damage you take back at the attacker.

Magic Pierce.name: Magic Pierce
Magic Pierce.desc:
Your spells ignore part of the enemy's MDEF. Can be cast on others.
MDEF penetration: 3 per level
DEF penetration: 1 per level; works on autocasts.
Cast: 3 s variable + 1 s fixed

Rook's Wall.name: Rook's Wall
Rook's Wall.desc:
Reduces damage from long-range physical attacks, at the cost of lower ASPD and movement speed for the duration; the ASPD penalty shrinks with skill level. Casting it again cancels the Defender status.
Ranged damage reduction: 10% per level
Requires a Shield.

Night Raven: Counter Slash.note: Counter Slash endgame farm build (the owner's commit rotation: Shadow Slash, Midnight Eye, Counter Slash until Counter state ends, Typhoon Edge)
Night Raven: Counter Slash.profileName: Night Raven Counter Slash, owner commit+bait rotation, endgame farm search 2026-10-02 (518 kills/h)

Shadow Slash.name: Shadow Slash
Shadow Slash.desc:
You dash to the target and make 3 critical hit attempts.
Damage: 200% + 15% per level + 1% per LUK
Only the right-hand weapon's ATK is used.
+5% damage per Improve Dodge level while under Hallucination Walk.
Bonus crit rate: 5 + 5 per level
Requires a Dagger or Sword.
Cooldown: 4 s
Shadow Slash.summary: Dash-in opener: three crit attempts on the target. Puts you in melee instantly.

Midnight Eye.name: Midnight Eye
Midnight Eye.desc:
You strike the target directly and remove random buffs from it, while preparing Counter Slash.
Damage: 200% + 20% per level + 5% per INT
Chance: 50% + 5% per level (what for is unclear; not counted)
If Weapon Blocking is active, you enter the Counter state for 1 s per level.
Cast: 0.25 s variable + 0.25 s fixed
Cooldown: 15 s

Counter Slash.name: Counter Slash
Counter Slash.desc:
Usable only in the Counter state: damages enemies around you. Repeated casts grant Rolling Counters.
Damage: 200% + 10% per level + 1% per AGI
One extra hit per Rolling Counter, up to 6 hits.
Rolling Counters: max 5, last 3 s.
Cooldown: 0.6 s
Cost: also 10% of current SP per cast

Typhoon Edge.name: Typhoon Edge
Typhoon Edge.desc:
You unleash a wave of slashes at all targets in range; at high levels it also knocks them back.
Damage: 110% + 15% per level + 1% per STR
+10% per Rolling Counter.
Triple damage if a target is knocked into a wall.
Knockback: 5 cells, only at Lv6 or higher.
Cooldown: 5 s

Northern Cross.name: Northern Cross
Northern Cross.desc:
You strike an enemy with a perfect cross of slashes.
Damage: 200% + 30% per level + 2% per AGI
With dual swords: +15% per level.
Night Wound: +50% and +1% per DEX.
Cooldown: 1 s
Cost: also 3% of current HP

Definitive Dagger.name: Definitive Dagger
Definitive Dagger.desc:
You strike an enemy with quick hits and perfect preparation.
Damage: 100% + 30% per level + 2% per AGI
Damage is boosted with dual daggers.
Night Wound: +50% + 1% per DEX.
HIT: +5 per level
Range: 3
Cooldown: 1 s
Cost: also 3% of current SP

Weapon Blocking.name: Weapon Blocking
Weapon Blocking.desc:
While active, you have a chance to cancel an enemy's short-range damage. Each cancelled attack puts you in the Counter state for 5 s, during which Counter skills can be used.
Block chance: 15% + 2% per level
Requires dual-wielding any pair of weapons.
Cannot be cancelled manually.
Duration: 120 s

Southern Cross.name: Southern Cross
Southern Cross.desc:
You strike the enemy and give it a Night Wound for 5 s. Specific skills deal extra damage to a target with a Night Wound.
Damage: 200% + 30% per level + 1% per AGI
Night Wound: +25% damage per level against a wounded target.
Requires both hands equipped.
Cooldown: 2.5 s - 0.1 s per level

Back Stab.name: Back Stab
Back Stab.desc:
You teleport behind the enemy and strike.
Damage: 150% + 5% per level + 1% per AGI
Single-wielding a Dagger: the AGI bonus and the per-level bonus are tripled, plus 5% scaling per Improve Dodge level.
The enemy's back must be unobstructed.
Requires a Sword or Dagger.
Cooldown: 3 s
Cost: also 5% of current SP

Dark Claw.name: Dark Claw
Dark Claw.desc:
You leave a painful wound that removes the enemy's melee physical damage reflect for 5 s. During that time its melee reflect effects don't work and it takes 2% more melee physical damage per level.
Cooldown: 90 s

Rising Wings.name: Rising Wings
Rising Wings.desc:
You bond with your Raven, increasing weapon damage.
Overall attack bonus: 1% per level
Quadruples the Auto-Raven chance with Sword + Dagger.
Requires a Raven.
Cost: also 50% of current SP

Fury.name: Fury
Fury.desc:
Raises your power to the maximum: more CRIT for the duration, but slower SP regeneration. Enables Executioner class skills.
Sonic Blow base damage +50%.
Impact Tooth base damage +50%.
CRIT: +1 per level, doubled with Katars.
Requires a Shadow Orb.
Duration: 20 s + 10 s per level
Cooldown: 60 s

Hallucination Walk.name: Hallucination Walk
Hallucination Walk.desc:
Raises your movement speed to the maximum, increases FLEE and gives a chance to avoid magic attacks.
FLEE: +10 per level
Magic damage avoid chance: 5% per level
Requires a Shadow Orb.
Duration: 25 s + 5 s per level
Cooldown: 120 s

Enchant Poison.name: Enchant Poison
Enchant Poison.desc:
Coats your weapon with the Poison element for a time; poisoned weapons can inflict Poison.
All physical attacks become Poison element.
Poison chance: 3% + 1% per level on normal attacks, 0% against bosses. Skills do not roll the Poison chance.
Duration: 30 s + 15 s per level
Cost: also 50% of Max SP

Magic Pierce.name: Magic Pierce
Magic Pierce.desc:
Your spells ignore part of the enemy's MDEF. Can be cast on others.
MDEF penetration: 3 per level
DEF penetration: 1 per level; works on autocasts.
Cast: 3 s variable + 1 s fixed
